ConceptPage.title: The idea
ConceptPage.metaDescription: The story behind SVOLTA — a plant-forward Italian kitchen in Bangkok, born from a life of eating well.
ConceptPage.intro: SVOLTA means 'turn' in Italian. A life of travel, four cities, one kitchen.
ConceptPage.section1Body: Tigelle from Emilia. Takoyaki from Osaka. Nasi goreng from Southeast Asia. Hummus and baba ganoush from the Levant. The menu is a map of where we've eaten well.
ConceptPage.section2Body: Every dish happens to be plant-based. We don't lead with that. The carbonara — silken tofu, smoked, creamy — earns its place on its own terms. So does the ragù.
ConceptPage.section3Body: Thai aubergine under white miso. Coconut gelato in the affogato. Sriracha alongside the fries. The recipes are from everywhere; the ingredients grow here.
ConceptPage.conceptBody: SVOLTA does not exist. The brief, the brand, the menu and every word on this site are invented — a self-directed project to design a restaurant from scratch and build it properly. If you came looking for dinner in Ari, I'm sorry to disappoint.
